reviews.author: Anton Rudov
reviews.text:
Had my Triumph Speedmaster in for a regular service and had a really good experience. Great communication throughout, everything was explained clearly, and they kept me updated on the work. They even gave me a discount and, most importantly, treated the bike like it was their own

Also really appreciated the little things — friendly guys, a great atmosphere, and they even offered me a coffee while I was there. The bike came back in perfect shape. Definitely coming back. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Vlad Gvozdyk
reviews.text:
Thanks, guys! I stopped by today to have my Yamaha XSR700 serviced, and everything was great. We also chatted about a future Royal Enfield custom project, had a coffee and just enjoyed talking bikes.

Iron Custom Motors is a fantastic multi-brand workshop where you can not only get your bike properly looked after, but also bring your ideas to life and build something truly unique.

Great people, great atmosphere and quality work. Definitely my new go-to workshop. Highly recommended — five stars! ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

reviews.author: Vladimir Beck
reviews.text:
I brought my custom Harley-Davidson XR1200 to the workshop essentially dead, it wouldn’t even start and had electrical issues, on top of needing a serious mechanical service.

The guys brought the bike back to life and gave it a comprehensive service: diagnosed and fixed the electrical problems, overhauled the clutch, rebuilt the front fork, serviced the brakes, replaced the battery, fluids and filters, and took care of everything else needed to get the bike properly back on the road.

What impressed me most was the technical level of the team. They clearly know motorcycles inside out, approach the work systematically, and pay attention to the details that actually matter. Everything was properly diagnosed, explained and done to a very high standard.

The XR1200 is now running great and feels like a completely different bike. Excellent workshop, highly skilled people, and a place I would confidently trust with any motorcycle.

Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Алексей Бегунов
reviews.text:
Hi, my name is Alex.
I’ve been riding motorcycles since 2014. I rarely trust anyone with my bike and usually do all the maintenance myself.
Unfortunately, I ran into a problem that I couldn’t solve on my own.
The team changed the oil, filters, spark plugs, and tires, and they also found and fixed the issue that was preventing the engine from starting.
Thank you, Iron Custom Motors, for getting my bike back on the road. I’m happy to be riding again!
Five stars—you’ve earned them. Love you guys!

reviews.author: Dream Carua
reviews.text:
Without a doubt, the best motorcycle workshop I’ve visited in Portugal, and probably one of the best anywhere.

Iron Custom Motors is much more than a repair shop—it’s a true motorcycle museum and a place where you simply want to spend time. The atmosphere is incredible, with stunning custom bikes, racing history, and an obvious passion for motorcycles in every detail.

The service is absolutely outstanding. The team genuinely cares about every customer and every motorcycle, no matter how big or small the job is. Their attention to detail, technical knowledge, honesty, and professionalism are on another level. They explain everything clearly, keep you informed, and never cut corners.

I was also pleasantly surprised by the pricing. For this level of expertise and customer care, the prices are more than fair and represent exceptional value.

If you’re anywhere near Cascais or Lisbon and need motorcycle service, repairs, upgrades, or simply love motorcycles, this is the place to visit. Even if your bike doesn’t need anything, stop by for a coffee and enjoy the showroom—it’s worth the trip by itself.

Highly recommended. Five stars aren’t enough! 🏍️👏
